Attempt at work energy equation with 4 relevant terms; dimensionally correct. Allow sign errors. M0 for $$\frac{1}{2} \times m \times (6 - 5)^2$$.

$$m = \frac{341}{5.5} = 62$$

questions.stem_markdown: Two particles, $A$ and $B$, of masses $3\text{ kg}$ and $6\text{ kg}$ respectively, lie on a smooth horizontal plane. Initially, $B$ is at rest and $A$ is moving towards $B$ with speed $8\text{ m s}^{-1}$. After $A$ and $B$ collide, $A$ moves with speed $2\text{ m s}^{-1}$.\n\nFind the greater of the two possible total losses of kinetic energy due to the collision.

mark_scheme_items.content_markdown: For attempt at use of conservation of momentum.
mark_scheme_items.guidance_markdown: Must have three non-zero terms. Allow sign errors. Must have correct masses with relevant velocities. Their $v$ may be in the opposite direction. If $g$ included with the masses: Allow M1A0A1 for first three marks. Can then score M1M0A0 for final three marks.

mark_scheme_items.content_markdown: $3\; \backslash times\; 8\; =\; 3\; \backslash times\; 2\; +\; 6\; v$ Or $3\; \backslash times\; 8\; =\; -3\; \backslash times\; 2\; +\; 6\; v$

mark_scheme_items.guidance_markdown: Allow finding only $v\; =\; 3$, but if both speeds found they must both be correct

mark_scheme_items.content_markdown: $KE_{after}$ $=\; 0.5\; \backslash times\; 3\; \backslash times\; 2^2\; +\; 0.5\; \backslash times\; 6\; \backslash times\; their\; v_B^2$ $[=\; 33]$ if correct
mark_scheme_items.guidance_markdown: Allow use of any $v_B$ even if $<\; 0$ Using speed of 5, $KE_{after}\; =\; 0.5\; \backslash times\; 3\; \backslash times\; 2^2\; +\; 0.5\; \backslash times\; 6\; \backslash times\; their\; 5^2$ $[=\; 81]$ Candidates may work out the loss for each particle separately which only scores DM1 when losses subsequently added together.

mark_scheme_items.content_markdown: $KE_{loss}\; =\; \backslash times\; \backslash pm\; \backslash pm\; (\; 0.5\; \backslash times\; 3\; \backslash times\; 8^2\; -\; (\; 0.5\; \backslash times\; 3\; \backslash times\; 2^2\; +\; 0.5\; \backslash times\; 6\; \backslash times\; their\; 3^2)\; )$ $[=\; 96\; -\; 33]$ if correct
mark_scheme_items.guidance_markdown: If two speeds found then FT their lower speed, even if later choose the wrong loss. If only one speed found then FT their speed. If the candidate thinks that the particles coalesce then score M0 here

If both losses found, must state which is the greater. Only award this mark if no errors – e.g. the KE loss for $v\; =\; 5$ should be 15 J. If wrong then A0. Allow $-63$ [J]. Can score full marks even if only $v\; =\; 3$ is found.
